title: Review the sales pipeline each week
goal: Every open opportunity has a next step dated this week or later, every lead a reply sent or drafted, and every opportunity closed this week its outcome and reason.

steps.do: List leads with no first response, and for each draft the reply for the founder to send.
For each open opportunity, check its qualification against its stage and its stage age, move it where the evidence says, and propose closing the ones with no next step.
For each opportunity closed this week, write the win-loss reason and who gave it, and write a customer record for each win.
Send features buyers asked for to products and service complaints to customer service as handoffs.
Compare the venture's price and terms with each competitor's published price, citing each pricing page and the date it was read, and report the differences to the growth lead.

consider.why: A buyer compares prices, so a price set without the alternatives in view can lose a sale or leave money unasked for.
consider.when: The venture has a price and at least one competitor publishes one.

steps.do: Count this week's loss reasons and sources, and propose to the growth lead which opportunities and channels to work next week.

done_criteria.check: Does every open opportunity have a next step dated this week or later, every lead a reply sent or drafted, and every closed one an outcome?
